'''''Bravo 4''''' was the personal [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Rya Kirsch]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="CCG: Theed Palace Limited" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Kirsch used the fighter during the space battle and was killed when the ship was destroyed.<ref name="SWE1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Bravo 4'' appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] but was first identified as such in ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.
